items.value: Total Length: 78.8 inches — Made by combining two 39.4-inch sofa tables.

items: 【Fill Small Sofa Gaps Perfectly】No more wasted space! This 5.7-inch narrow console table is designed to fill the awkward small gap between your sectional sofa and the wall or window sills. This couch table behind sofa maximizes your sofa side space while creating a more coordinated space

【Flexible Charging Stations】Whether you’re lounging solo or hosting a gathering, this thin console table offers multiple charging options right behind your sofa. With 2 AC outlets, 1 USB port, and 1 Type-C port, you’ll always have easy access to power. Plus, when you combine 2 tables behind couch, you can position the charging station on the side or in the middle, making it even more convenient

【Extra Storage Space Behind the Sofa】Save the lmited space around sofa, now, you can put a thin lamp, small basket for reading glasses, remote or a cupr of drink whenever you cozy up on the sofa. Despite its narrow design, this living room console table adds valuable storage without taking up extra space

【Multiple Uses with High Quality】Whether as a plant table between your sofa and window, a console table behind couch, or a skinny entryway table, this entry console table is as versatile as it is durable. Crafted with sturdy engineered wood and a metal frame, it’s built to last. Plus: The entire desktop consists of 3 panels

【Quick Assembly and Stability】With easy-to-follow instructions, simple construction, and included tools, you can have this sofa table with outlet assembled in just 15 minutes. For added stability, attach it to the wall, and use the adjustable feet to keep it level on uneven floors
